name: gaussianslim-renderer
description: GaussianSlim WebGL renderer with compact Gaussian loading and decoding
author: Mark Kellogg

scripts.build-library: npx rollup -c && mkdir -p ./build/demo/lib && cp ./build/gaussian-splats-3d* ./build/demo/lib/ && cp ./src/loaders/compactLoader/gaussianslim_wasm.js ./src/loaders/compactLoader/gaussianslim_wasm.wasm ./src/loaders/compactLoader/gaussianslim_reconstruction_wasm.js ./src/loaders/compactLoader/gaussianslim_reconstruction_wasm.wasm ./src/loaders/compactLoader/SplatDecoderBootstrap.worker.js ./src/loaders/compactLoader/SplatDecoder.worker.js ./src/loaders/compactLoader/SplatReconstruction.worker.js ./src/loaders/compactLoader/WebCodecsVideoDecoder.js ./src/loaders/compactLoader/WebCodecsCapabilityCanary.js ./src/loaders/compactLoader/TextureStrategy.js ./build/demo/lib/ && for file in ./src/loaders/compactLoader/gaussianslim_wasm_pthread.js ./src/loaders/compactLoader/gaussianslim_wasm_pthread.wasm ./src/loaders/compactLoader/gaussianslim_wasm_pthread.worker.js; do [ ! -f "$file" ] || cp "$file" ./build/demo/lib/; done
scripts.build: npm run build-library && npm run build-demo
scripts.build-demo-windows: (if not exist ".\build\demo" mkdir .\build\demo) && xcopy /E .\demo .\build\demo && xcopy .\node_modules\three\build\three.module.js .\build\demo\lib\ && copy .\browser.html .\build\demo\browser.html
scripts.build-library-windows: npx rollup -c && (if not exist ".\build\demo\lib" mkdir .\build\demo\lib) && copy .\build\gaussian-splats-3d* .\build\demo\lib\ && copy .\src\loaders\compactLoader\gaussianslim_wasm.js .\build\demo\lib\ && copy .\src\loaders\compactLoader\gaussianslim_wasm.wasm .\build\demo\lib\ && copy .\src\loaders\compactLoader\gaussianslim_reconstruction_wasm.js .\build\demo\lib\ && copy .\src\loaders\compactLoader\gaussianslim_reconstruction_wasm.wasm .\build\demo\lib\ && copy .\src\loaders\compactLoader\SplatDecoderBootstrap.worker.js .\build\demo\lib\ && copy .\src\loaders\compactLoader\SplatDecoder.worker.js .\build\demo\lib\ && copy .\src\loaders\compactLoader\SplatReconstruction.worker.js .\build\demo\lib\ && copy .\src\loaders\compactLoader\WebCodecsVideoDecoder.js .\build\demo\lib\ && copy .\src\loaders\compactLoader\WebCodecsCapabilityCanary.js .\build\demo\lib\ && copy .\src\loaders\compactLoader\TextureStrategy.js .\build\demo\lib\ && (if exist .\src\loaders\compactLoader\gaussianslim_wasm_pthread.js copy .\src\loaders\compactLoader\gaussianslim_wasm_pthread.js .\build\demo\lib\) && (if exist .\src\loaders\compactLoader\gaussianslim_wasm_pthread.wasm copy .\src\loaders\compactLoader\gaussianslim_wasm_pthread.wasm .\build\demo\lib\) && (if exist .\src\loaders\compactLoader\gaussianslim_wasm_pthread.worker.js copy .\src\loaders\compactLoader\gaussianslim_wasm_pthread.worker.js .\build\demo\lib\)
scripts.build-windows: npm run build-library-windows && npm run build-demo-windows
